portal.name: Lung Radiology FM Portal
portal.tagline: Open-weight lung cancer CT, LDCT, PET/CT & chest X-ray foundation models on one PACS bench.

families.name: Lung Cancer Risk & 3D CT Encoders
families.description: 3D volumetric foundation encoders and longitudinal screening models for 1-6 year lung cancer risk prediction, nodule malignancy stratification, radiomic biomarkers, and survival prognosis.

families.name: 3D Chest CT Vision-Language & Report FMs
families.description: Volumetric vision-language foundation models aligning 3D thoracic CT scans with radiology reports and EHR codes for zero-shot multi-abnormality triage, structured reporting, and clinical VQA.

families.name: 3D Lung, Nodule, Airway & Tumor Segmentation
families.description: Automatic, text-prompted, and interactively promptable 3D segmentation foundation models for NSCLC gross tumor volumes (GTV), pulmonary nodules, 5 lung lobes, airways, vessels, and thoracic OARs.

families.name: 2D Chest X-Ray Foundation & Grounded VLMs
families.description: Self-supervised and vision-language chest radiograph foundation models supporting data-efficient lung lesion screening, temporal progression analysis, and bounding-box-grounded report generation.

families.name: Thoracic CT & CXR Generative Synthesis
families.description: 3D volumetric and 2D text-conditional diffusion foundation models for synthetic chest CT, paired tumor/organ mask synthesis, rare-pathology augmentation, and privacy-preserving simulation.

tasks.label: Lung Cancer Risk (1-6 Yr)
tasks.description: Predict 1-6 year incident lung cancer probability, Lung-RADS v2022 risk tier, and malignancy score from a single LDCT.

tasks.label: 3D Biomarker Embeddings
tasks.description: Extract fixed-length 3D volumetric or nodule-centered feature vectors for linear probing, survival modeling, and cohort retrieval.

tasks.label: 3D CT Report & VQA
tasks.description: Generate structured thoracic CT findings, impression, Lung-RADS recommendations, and multi-abnormality zero-shot probabilities.

tasks.label: 3D Tumor, Nodule & Lobe Seg
tasks.description: Produce volumetric masks and quantitative 3D RECIST / volumetry for NSCLC GTVs, pulmonary nodules, 5 lobes, airways, and OARs.

tasks.label: CXR Triage & Localization
tasks.description: Zero-shot or linear-probe thoracic pathology scoring, nodule/mass localization, and temporal comparison on chest radiographs.

tasks.label: Grounded CXR Reporting
tasks.description: Draft structured chest X-ray radiology reports with phrase-grounded bounding boxes for nodules, opacities, and effusions.

tasks.label: Synthetic CT / CXR Generation
tasks.description: Synthesize text- or mask-conditioned 3D chest CT volumes or chest radiographs for augmentation and reader studies.

models.name: Sybil
models.org: MIT Jameel Clinic & Mass General Hospital
models.architecture: 3D ResNet-18 + Multi-Scale Attention Pooling (5-model ensemble)
models.pretrain_data: 28,162 NLST LDCT volumes (biopsy-confirmed 6-yr outcomes)
models.key_metric: NLST 1-yr AUC 0.92 | 6-yr C-index 0.75 (MGH 0.81, CGMH 0.80)
models.summary: Validated clinical deep learning model predicting individual 1- to 6-year future lung cancer risk directly from a single low-dose chest CT without requiring manual nodule annotations or smoking demographics.
models.cli_snippet:
pip install sybil
python -c "from sybil import Serie, Sybil; m = Sybil('sybil_ensemble'); print(m.predict([Serie(dicoms)]))"

models.name: Pillar-0 (Chest CT)
models.architecture: Atlas Native-3D Asymmetric Vision Transformer + RATE Supervision
models.input_spec: Native 3D multi-window Chest CT (Lung + Mediastinal + Bone HU channels)
models.pretrain_data: Large-scale clinical 3D CT/MRI corpus with RATE LLM-extracted findings
models.key_metric: SOTA across 300+ thoracic findings; powers Sybil-1.5 (+3.0 C-index on NLST)
models.summary: Native 3D radiology foundation model using the Atlas volumetric architecture and multi-window HU inputs, eliminating 2D slice flattening and outperforming prior medical VLMs across thoracic diagnostic tasks.
models.cli_snippet:
huggingface-cli download YalaLab/Pillar0-ChestCT --local-dir ./weights/pillar0
# See https://huggingface.co/collections/YalaLab/pillar-0

models.name: Sybil-1.5 (Pillar-0)
models.org: Yala Lab, MIT Jameel Clinic & MGH
models.architecture: Pillar-0 Atlas-3D Backbone + Cumulative Hazard Lung Cancer Head
models.pretrain_data: Pillar-0 3D CT pretraining + fine-tuned on NLST screening cohort
models.key_metric: 1-yr AUROC: 0.945 NLST | 0.908 MGH (+5.9 C-idx) | 0.968 CGMH
models.summary: Next-generation lung cancer risk foundation model built by fine-tuning Pillar-0 Chest CT, delivering substantial external generalization gains over original Sybil across US and Asian screening cohorts.
models.cli_snippet:
huggingface-cli download YalaLab/Sybil-1.5 --local-dir ./weights/sybil15
python -m pillar_finetune.eval --ckpt ./weights/sybil15 --scan scan.nii.gz

models.name: CT-FM
models.architecture: 3D SegResNet Encoder pretrained with Label-Agnostic Contrastive SSL
models.pretrain_data: 148,000 CT scans from NCI Imaging Data Commons (IDC)
models.key_metric: 148K IDC CT pretraining; SOTA semantic organ retrieval & lung tumor transfer
models.summary: Large-scale 3D whole-CT foundation encoder trained purely with self-supervised contrastive learning across 148,000 public NCI IDC scans for downstream lung tumor segmentation, triage, and radiomic embedding.
models.cli_snippet:
pip install lighter-ct-fm
python -c "from lighter_ct_fm import CTFMFeatureExtractor; m = CTFMFeatureExtractor.from_pretrained('project-lighter/ct_fm_segresnet')"

models.name: FMCIB
models.architecture: 3D ResNet-50 (SimCLR Lesion-Centered Contrastive SSL)
models.pretrain_data: 11,467 annotated radiographic lesions from NIH DeepLesion
models.key_metric: LUNA16 malignancy AUC 0.91 | NSCLC-Radiomics survival C-index 0.65 (linear probe)
models.summary: Foundation Model for Cancer Imaging Biomarkers trained specifically on 3D tumor/lesion crops, excelling at pulmonary nodule malignancy prediction and NSCLC prognostication in low-data regimes.
models.cli_snippet:
pip install foundation-cancer-image-biomarker
python -c "from fmcib.models import fmcib_model; model = fmcib_model()"

models.name: SuPreM
models.architecture: 3D SwinUNETR / SegResNet / U-Net Supervised Pretraining Suite
models.pretrain_data: 9,262 3D CT volumes with 25-organ & tumor pseudo/manual masks (AbdomenAtlas 1.1)
models.key_metric: ICLR 2024 Oral; +5-12% DSC gain on MSD Task06 Lung & low-shot tumor segmentation
models.summary: Demonstrates that supervised anatomical pretraining on large-scale 3D CT masks yields highly transferable representations for lung cancer segmentation and small-lesion detection.
models.cli_snippet:
git clone https://github.com/MrGiovanni/SuPreM.git
# Download supervised_suprem_swinunetr_2100.pth from releases

models.name: VoCo / VoCo-v2
models.architecture: Swin-B / Swin-H 3D Volume Contrastive SSL
models.input_spec: 96x96x96 3D CT crops with geometric position prediction
models.pretrain_data: 160,000 unlabeled 3D CT volumes (PreCT-160K incl. LIDC, NLST, STOIC)
models.key_metric: Pretrained on 160K CTs; SOTA SSL transfer on MSD Lung, BTCV & nodule classification
models.summary: Simple yet effective 3D volume contrastive self-supervised framework exploiting consistent anatomical positional priors across 160K chest and body CT volumes.
models.cli_snippet:
git clone https://github.com/Luffy03/VoCo.git
# Load VoCo_B_SSL_head.pt into MONAI SwinUNETR backbone

models.name: Med3D (MedicalNet)
models.pretrain_data: 3DSeg-8 multi-domain 3D medical datasets incl. LIDC lung & vessels
models.key_metric: Lightweight 2 GB baseline; widely benchmarked on LUNA16 & NSCLC radiomics
models.summary: Pioneering open-weight 3D medical transfer-learning backbone family that accelerates convergence on pulmonary nodule classification and lung segmentation on modest GPUs or CPUs.
models.cli_snippet:
git clone https://github.com/Tencent/MedicalNet.git
# Load resnet_50_23dataset.pth for 3D nodule feature extraction

models.name: CT-CLIP
models.architecture: 3D CT-ViT Spatial-Depth Transformer + CXR-BERT Text Encoder
models.pretrain_data: CT-RATE (50,188 3D Chest CT volumes + radiology reports, 25,692 patients)
models.key_metric: CT-RATE 18-finding zero-shot AUROC 0.731 | VocabFine 0.818 | RadChestCT external 0.72
models.summary: Landmark 3D chest CT contrastive vision-language foundation model enabling zero-shot multi-abnormality screening (lung nodule, mass, consolidation, emphysema, effusion) and cross-modal volume-to-report retrieval.
models.cli_snippet:
git clone https://github.com/ibrahimethemhamamci/CT-CLIP.git
huggingface-cli download ibrahimhamamci/CT-RATE --include 'models/CT-CLIP/*'

models.name: CT-CHAT
models.architecture: CT-CLIP 3D Vision Encoder + Multimodal Projector + Llama 3.1 8B
models.pretrain_data: CT-RATE + 2.7M 3D chest CT visual QA & structured report dialogues
models.key_metric: First 3D Chest CT conversational VLM trained on 2.7M CT-RATE Q&A pairs
models.summary: Interactive 3D chest CT multimodal assistant extending CT-CLIP with Llama 3.1 for free-text radiology report drafting, lung nodule characterization, and interactive thoracic clinical VQA.
models.cli_snippet:
# Accept Llama 3.1 & CT-CHAT terms on Hugging Face first
python CT_CHAT/llava/serve/cli.py --model-path ibrahimhamamci/CT-CHAT --ct-file scan.nii.gz

models.name: Merlin
models.architecture: Inflated 3D ResNet-152 + Clinical Longformer / RadLlama VLM
models.pretrain_data: 15,331 clinical CT scans + 1.8M EHR ICD codes + 6M report tokens
models.key_metric: Zero-shot 30-finding AUROC 0.81 | 5-yr chronic disease & cancer risk C-index 0.75
models.summary: 3D CT vision-language foundation model co-trained on volumetric scans, structured EHR phenotypes, and unstructured radiology reports for multi-disease classification, prognosis, and report drafting.
models.cli_snippet:
pip install merlin-vlm
python -c "from merlin import Merlin; model = Merlin(ImageEmbedding=True)"

models.name: M3D-LaMed
models.architecture: M3D-CLIP 3D ViT + Spatial Pooling Perceiver + Llama-2 / Phi-3 + SegVol Head
models.pretrain_data: M3D-Data (120K 3D CT/MRI image-text pairs, 662K VQA instructions)
models.key_metric: Unified 3D report generation, VQA, retrieval & referring tumor segmentation
models.summary: Versatile 3D multimodal LLM supporting thoracic CT report generation, open/closed clinical VQA, image-text retrieval, and text-referred 3D lesion segmentation in one architecture.
models.cli_snippet:
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained('GoodBaiBai88/M3D-LaMed-Phi-3-4B', trust_remote_code=True)

models.name: RadFM
models.org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University & Shanghai AI Lab
models.architecture: 3D ViT + Perceiver Resampler + MedLLaMA-13B
models.input_spec: Interleaved 2D CXR or 3D CT volumes (up to 512x512x64) + text
models.pretrain_data: MedMD (16M 2D & 3D medical scans incl. Chest CT, LIDC, MIMIC-CXR)
models.key_metric: First 14B generalist 2D+3D radiology foundation model across 5,000+ diseases
models.summary: Generalist multimodal foundation model accepting arbitrary interleaved sequences of 2D chest radiographs and 3D chest CT scans for diagnosis, modality recognition, VQA, and reporting.
models.cli_snippet:
huggingface-cli download chaoyi-wu/RadFM --local-dir ./weights/RadFM
python Quick_demo/test.py

models.name: MedGemma-4B / 1.5
models.architecture: MedSigLIP-400M Vision Encoder + Gemma 3 4B Multimodal Decoder
models.input_spec: 896x896 CXR or multi-slice Thoracic CT window stacks
models.pretrain_data: De-identified CXR, Chest CT slice stacks, histopathology & clinical text
models.key_metric: 88.9% CheXpert F1 | 81% clinician-acceptable CXR reports | MedGemma 1.5 3D CT
models.summary: Compact 4B open-weight multimodal medical LLM optimized for clinical radiology image-text reasoning, chest X-ray reporting, and CT slice stack interpretation (extended to 3D CT in MedGemma 1.5).
models.cli_snippet:
from transformers import pipeline
pipe = pipeline('image-text-to-text', model='google/medgemma-4b-it')

models.name: TotalSegmentator v2 (Thorax)
models.architecture: nnU-Net v2 Multi-Task 3D Cascade (117 anatomy + lung_nodules + vessels)
models.pretrain_data: 1,228 clinical CT scans + dedicated lung nodule, vessel & pleural effusion sets
models.key_metric: Mean DSC 0.943 across 104+ organs; includes 5 lung lobes, nodules & vessels
models.summary: Clinical gold-standard open-source 3D CT segmentation engine supporting 5 pulmonary lobes, trachea, ribs, thoracic vessels, pleural effusion, and dedicated pulmonary nodule segmentation out of the box.
models.cli_snippet:
pip install TotalSegmentator
TotalSegmentator -i chest_ct.nii.gz -o seg_out --task lung_nodules

models.name: VISTA3D
models.architecture: 3D SegResNet + Unified Automatic & 3D Point-Prompted Interactive Decoder
models.input_spec: 1.5mm isotropic 3D CT + optional 3D foreground/background click prompts
models.pretrain_data: 11,454 3D CT volumes covering 127 anatomical & tumor classes incl. MSD Lung
models.key_metric: 127 automatic classes + zero-shot interactive lung tumor refinement in 1 click
models.summary: Unified 3D CT segmentation foundation model combining everything-mode automatic parsing of 127 structures (5 lung lobes, lung tumor, airways, thoracic OARs) with interactive 3D point correction.
models.cli_snippet:
python -m monai.bundle download vista3d --bundle_dir ./bundles
python -m monai.bundle run --config_file ./bundles/vista3d/configs/inference.json

models.name: nnInteractive
models.architecture: Residual-Encoder 3D nnU-Net with Point, Box, Scribble & Lasso Prompts
models.pretrain_data: 120+ heterogeneous 3D public datasets (CT, PET/CT, MRI, lung tumors & lesions)
models.key_metric: SOTA open-set 3D interactive lesion contouring across CT & FDG-PET/CT
models.summary: Open-set 3D promptable segmentation foundation model built on nnU-Net principles, delivering sub-second interactive contouring of pulmonary nodules, spiculated NSCLC GTVs, lymph nodes, and PET-avid metastases.
models.cli_snippet:
pip install nninteractive
# Supports napari plugin (napari-nninteractive) and Python session API

models.name: SegVol
models.architecture: 3D ViT Zoom-Out-Zoom-In Encoder + CLIP Text & Spatial Prompt Decoder
models.input_spec: Full-volume 3D CT + text ('lung tumor', 'right upper lobe') / box / point
models.pretrain_data: 90,000 unlabeled 3D CTs (SimMIM SSL) + 6,000 labeled CTs across 200+ categories
models.key_metric: NeurIPS 2024; 200+ anatomical/lesion classes via zoom-out-zoom-in 3D inference
models.summary: Universal 3D volumetric CT segmentation model combining semantic text prompting with spatial point/box refinement via a dual-resolution zoom-out-zoom-in mechanism suited to small lung tumors.
models.cli_snippet:
from transformers import AutoModel
model = AutoModel.from_pretrained('BAAI/SegVol', trust_remote_code=True)

models.name: MedSAM2
models.org: University of Toronto & UHN (Bo Wang Lab)
models.architecture: SAM 2 Hiera Vision Transformer + Bidirectional 3D Memory Propagation
models.input_spec: 3D CT/PET slice stack (treated as volumetric video) + 1 bounding box / click
models.pretrain_data: 455,000+ 3D medical image-mask pairs incl. LUNA25 nodules & NSCLC tumors
models.key_metric: Generates 3D masks for LUNA25 nodules from a single axial box prompt
models.summary: Volumetric adaptation of SAM 2 leveraging bidirectional slice-memory propagation for rapid one-prompt 3D lung nodule segmentation, NSCLC tumor contouring, and longitudinal RECIST tracking.
models.cli_snippet:
git clone https://github.com/bowang-lab/MedSAM2.git
huggingface-cli download wanglab/MedSAM2 --local-dir ./checkpoints

models.name: SAT (Segment Anything w/ Text)
models.org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University & Shanghai AI Lab
models.architecture: 3D U-Net / SwinUNETR + Medical Knowledge-Tree Text Encoder
models.input_spec: 3D CT / PET / MRI volume + anatomical or tumor text prompt
models.pretrain_data: SAT-DS (22,186 3D scans across 72 public datasets & 497 anatomical/tumor targets)
models.key_metric: 497 text-promptable classes across CT, PET & MRI; rivals specialist nnU-Nets
models.summary: Knowledge-enhanced universal 3D segmentation foundation model trained on 72 unified datasets (SAT-DS), capable of segmenting lung tumors, lobes, airways, mediastinal nodes, and PET-CT lesions via text prompts.
models.cli_snippet:
git clone https://github.com/zhaoziheng/SAT.git
python inference.py --rcd_dir ./samples --text_prompt 'lung tumor,right upper lung lobe'

models.name: LungMask (R231 / LTRCLobes)
models.architecture: Multi-Pathology 2.5D/3D U-Net (R231 + LTRCLobes fusion)
models.input_spec: Any routine or pathological Chest CT (DICOM / NIfTI / MHA)
models.pretrain_data: Diverse multi-center routine clinical CTs with severe consolidation, tumors & fibrosis
models.key_metric: DSC 0.98 on routine/pathological lungs; standard preprocessing for lung AI pipelines
models.summary: Battle-tested clinical lung and 5-lobe CT segmentation benchmark specifically engineered to remain robust in the presence of large lung masses, pleural effusions, fibrosis, and post-resection anatomy.
models.cli_snippet:
pip install lungmask
lungmask chest_ct.nii.gz lobes_mask.nii.gz --modelname LTRCLobes_R231

models.name: BiomedParse
models.architecture: FocalNet Vision Backbone + SEEM Text-Prompted Joint Parser
models.input_spec: 1024x1024 CT slice / CXR + natural language target prompt
models.pretrain_data: BiomedParseData (6M+ image-mask-label triples across 9 biomedical modalities)
models.key_metric: Joint text-prompted segmentation, detection & recognition across 9 modalities
models.summary: All-in-one biomedical parsing foundation model that segments and detects irregular lung tumors, infiltrates, and thoracic structures from natural-language prompts without bounding boxes.
models.cli_snippet:
git clone https://github.com/microsoft/BiomedParse.git
# Weights auto-download from huggingface.co/microsoft/BiomedParse

models.name: Ark+
models.architecture: Swin-Large Transformer with Cyclic Multi-Source Knowledge Accrual
models.pretrain_data: 700,000+ CXRs accrued across MIMIC-CXR, CheXpert, NIH-14, PadChest, VinDr & ShenZhen
models.key_metric: Outperforms proprietary CXR models across 6 multi-institutional lung/thorax benchmarks
models.summary: Fully open chest radiography foundation model trained via cyclic student-teacher accrual across heterogeneous public datasets without manual label harmonization, excelling on lung nodule, mass, and rare pathology detection.
models.cli_snippet:
git clone https://github.com/jlianglab/Ark.git
# Load ark6_swinLarge768_ep50.pth.tar via timm Swin-L

models.name: RAD-DINO
models.architecture: DINOv2 ViT-B/14 Unimodal Self-Supervised Image Encoder
models.pretrain_data: 838,000+ public CXRs (MIMIC-CXR, CheXpert, PadChest, NIH-14, BRAX)
models.key_metric: SOTA unimodal CXR encoder; backbone for MAIRA-2 grounded report generation
models.summary: Pure-image self-supervised DINOv2 foundation encoder for chest radiography demonstrating that scaling unimodal visual pretraining outperforms text-supervised encoders across classification, lung segmentation, and report generation.
models.cli_snippet:
from transformers import AutoModel, AutoImageProcessor
model = AutoModel.from_pretrained('microsoft/rad-dino')

models.name: MAIRA-2
models.architecture: RAD-DINO ViT-B/14 + 4-layer MLP Connector + Vicuna-7B
models.input_spec: 518x518 Frontal + optional Lateral + optional Prior CXR & indication
models.pretrain_data: MIMIC-CXR, PadChest, USMix, VinDr-CXR & MS-CXR grounded phrase boxes
models.key_metric: Top ReXrank RadGraph-F1 & phrase-grounded bounding-box localization
models.summary: Grounded chest X-ray report generation foundation model that links every reported lung nodule, opacity, pneumothorax, or effusion directly to spatial bounding boxes while comparing against prior scans.
models.cli_snippet:
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoProcessor
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained('microsoft/maira-2', trust_remote_code=True)

models.name: CheXagent-2
models.architecture: SigLIP-SO400M + Qwen/Mistral Instruction-Tuned CXR VLM (3B & 8B)
models.pretrain_data: CheXinstruct (6.1M image-instruction-answer triplets across 28 CXR datasets)
models.key_metric: Leads CheXbench across 8 CXR perception, localization & reporting tasks
models.summary: Instruction-tuned chest X-ray foundation agent capable of view classification, pulmonary nodule detection, abnormality grounding, VQA, and structured findings/impression drafting.
models.cli_snippet:
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained('StanfordAIMI/CheXagent-2-3b', trust_remote_code=True)

models.name: CheXzero
models.architecture: CLIP ViT-B/32 Contrastive CXR-Report Alignment
models.pretrain_data: 377,110 MIMIC-CXR images + unannotated free-text radiology impressions
models.key_metric: Matches board-certified radiologists (F1 0.606 vs 0.619) with zero explicit labels
models.summary: Landmark zero-shot chest X-ray pathology classifier trained solely on raw radiology report impressions, enabling instant querying of arbitrary thoracic findings including lung lesions without retraining.
models.cli_snippet:
git clone https://github.com/rajpurkarlab/CheXzero.git
python zero_shot.py --cxr_filepath ./cxr.h5 --pair_template 'Lung Lesion'

models.name: CXR Foundation (ELIXR)
models.architecture: EfficientNet-L2 SupCon + ELIXR Q-Former Text Alignment
models.input_spec: DICOM / PNG Chest X-ray -> 1376-d / 128x768 ELIXR embeddings
models.pretrain_data: 821,544 multi-site chest radiographs (US & India cohorts)
models.key_metric: High-accuracy lung nodule/opacity classifiers with 10x fewer labeled scans
models.summary: Data-efficient chest X-ray embedding model that generates rich image and vision-language representations, allowing clinical teams to train specialized lung nodule and TB detectors with minimal local annotations.
models.cli_snippet:
huggingface-cli download google/cxr-foundation --local-dir ./weights/cxr_foundation
# Use SavedModel / Keras API from Google-Health/cxr-foundation

models.name: BioViL-T
models.architecture: Hybrid CNN + Multi-Image Temporal Transformer + CXR-BERT
models.pretrain_data: Longitudinal MIMIC-CXR paired exams & interval-change radiology reports
models.key_metric: SOTA longitudinal progression classification & MS-CXR phrase grounding
models.summary: Temporal vision-language chest X-ray model explicitly encoding prior comparison scans to detect interval enlargement of pulmonary lesions, resolving consolidations, or new pleural effusions.
models.cli_snippet:
pip install hi-ml-multimodal
# Load microsoft/BiomedVLP-BioViL-T via health_multimodal.image

models.name: BiomedCLIP
models.architecture: ViT-B/16 Vision Encoder + PubMedBERT-256 Contrastive Backbone
models.input_spec: 224x224 CXR or 2D CT key slice + biomedical text prompt
models.pretrain_data: PMC-15M (15M PubMed Central biomedical figure-caption pairs)
models.key_metric: Strong zero-shot cross-modal radiology retrieval & 2D slice triage on 2 GB VRAM
models.summary: Broadly adopted biomedical CLIP foundation model pretrained on 15 million scientific image-caption pairs, serving as a fast zero-shot baseline for chest radiographs, lung CT key slices, and histopathology.
models.cli_snippet:
pip install open_clip_torch
# open_clip.create_model_from_pretrained('hf-hub:microsoft/BiomedCLIP-PubMedBERT_256-vit_base_patch16_224')

models.name: MAISI (3D CT Diffusion)
models.architecture: 3D Autoencoder + Latent Diffusion + ControlNet Mask Conditioning
models.input_spec: Target spacing + body region ('chest') + optional 127-class mask incl. lung tumor
models.pretrain_data: 50,000+ multi-region 3D CT volumes (chest, abdomen, pelvis, head/neck)
models.key_metric: Generates 512x512x512 chest CTs with pixel-aligned lung tumor & organ masks
models.summary: Medical AI for Synthetic Imaging generating high-resolution 3D volumetric chest CTs paired with exact lung tumor and thoracic organ segmentation masks for privacy-free data augmentation.
models.cli_snippet:
python -m monai.bundle download maisi_ct_generative --bundle_dir ./bundles
python -m monai.bundle run --config_file ./bundles/maisi_ct_generative/configs/inference.json

models.name: GenerateCT
models.architecture: CT-ViT 3D Causal Transformer + T5 Text Encoder + 2D SR Diffusion
models.input_spec: Free-text thoracic radiology prompt -> 512x512x201 3D Chest CT volume
models.pretrain_data: CT-RATE (25,692 patients / 50,188 paired chest CT & radiology reports)
models.key_metric: First text-conditional 3D chest CT volumetric synthesis model (ECCV 2024)
models.summary: Text-to-3D-CT foundation generator capable of synthesizing anatomically coherent chest CT volumes with requested pulmonary nodules, consolidation, pleural effusion, or emphysema.
models.cli_snippet:
git clone https://github.com/ibrahimethemhamamci/GenerateCT.git
python inference.py --prompt 'Spiculated 18mm nodule in the right upper lobe'

models.name: RoentGen
models.architecture: Fine-tuned Latent Diffusion Model (Stable Diffusion UNet + CLIP Text)
models.input_spec: Free-text CXR radiology impression -> 512x512 Chest X-ray
models.pretrain_data: MIMIC-CXR frontal radiographs & radiology report impressions
models.key_metric: Boosts minority-class CXR pathology classification when used for synthetic augmentation
models.summary: Text-conditioned chest X-ray latent diffusion model generating realistic radiographs matching specified thoracic findings (nodule, pneumothorax, effusion, cardiomegaly) for training augmentation.
models.cli_snippet:
from diffusers import StableDiffusionPipeline
pipe = StableDiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained('stanfordmimi/RoentGen')

datasets.name: NLST (National Lung Screening Trial)
datasets.annotations: Biopsy-proven lung cancer diagnosis, TNM stage, histology, 6-yr mortality, plus public MIT/Sybil nodule bounding boxes
datasets.cli_hint: idc-index download --collection nlst   # NCI Imaging Data Commons (open subset)

datasets.name: LIDC-IDRI
datasets.annotations: 4-radiologist consensus 3D contours for nodules >=3mm plus semantic spiculation, subtlety, lobulation, texture & malignancy ratings (1-5)
datasets.cli_hint:
pip install pylidc idc-index
idc-index download --collection lidc_idri

datasets.name: LUNA16 (LUng Nodule Analysis 2016)
datasets.annotations: Standardized 10-fold CV split, consensus nodule centroids (>=3 radiologists), diameters, candidate coordinates & lung masks
datasets.cli_hint:
# Download subsets 0-9 from Zenodo record 3723295 / 4121926
zenodo_get 3723295

datasets.name: LUNA25 (Indeterminate Nodule Risk)
datasets.annotations: Biopsy/clinical malignancy ground truth for indeterminate screening nodules, 3D coordinates, plus MedSAM2-assisted 3D nodule masks
datasets.cli_hint:
# Public imaging data on Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14223624
zenodo_get 14223624

datasets.name: Duke Lung Cancer Screening (DLCSD24)
datasets.annotations: 3D nodule bounding boxes, Lung-RADS categories, and biopsy-confirmed lung cancer outcomes from a real-world US health system
datasets.cli_hint: zenodo_get 13799069   # Duke Lung Cancer Screening Dataset 2024

datasets.name: CT-RATE
datasets.annotations: Paired free-text radiology findings/impressions, 18 multi-label thoracic abnormalities (incl. lung nodule, consolidation, effusion, emphysema) & 2.7M VQA pairs
datasets.access: Open on Hugging Face (Gated CC BY-NC-SA)

datasets.name: RAD-ChestCT
datasets.annotations: 83 thoracic abnormality labels (pulmonary nodule, mass, consolidation, pleural effusion, atelectasis, emphysema, etc.) extracted from Duke clinical reports
datasets.cli_hint: # Request access on Zenodo record 6406114 (Duke RAD-ChestCT)

datasets.name: NSCLC-Radiomics (Lung1)
datasets.annotations: Manual 3D Gross Tumor Volume (GTV-1) and OAR delineations by radiation oncologists, TNM stage, histology, and overall survival time

datasets.name: NSCLC Radiogenomics
datasets.annotations: 3D tumor masks (144 pts), semantic radiological traits, EGFR/KRAS/ALK mutation status, RNA-seq & microarray profiles, and clinical survival

datasets.name: Lung-PET-CT-Dx
datasets.annotations: Expert 3D tumor bounding boxes paired with biopsy-confirmed histopathological subtype (Adenocarcinoma, Squamous Cell, Small Cell, Large Cell)

datasets.name: MSD Task06 Lung
datasets.annotations: Voxel-accurate 3D primary non-small cell lung cancer tumor segmentation masks standardized for the Medical Segmentation Decathlon
datasets.cli_hint: python -c "from monai.apps import DecathlonDataset; DecathlonDataset('./data', 'Task06_Lung', 'training', download=True)"

datasets.name: LNDb (Lung Nodule Database)
datasets.annotations: Radiologist 3D nodule segmentations, nodule texture (solid/part-solid/GGN), and Fleischner Society follow-up management classes

datasets.name: AutoPET (FDG-PET/CT Lesions)
datasets.annotations: Expert 3D metabolic tumor segmentations across histologically proven lung cancer, lymphoma, melanoma & negative control exams

datasets.name: ATM'22 & SegTHOR (Airway & Thoracic OARs)
datasets.annotations: Fine-grained 3D pulmonary airway trees (trachea to peripheral bronchi) + radiotherapy thoracic organs at risk (heart, aorta, trachea, esophagus)

datasets.name: MIMIC-CXR v2.0
datasets.annotations: Full free-text radiology reports, 14 structured CheXpert/NegBio labels (incl. Lung Lesion), plus MS-CXR bounding boxes & longitudinal priors

datasets.name: CheXpert / CheXpert Plus
datasets.annotations: Uncertainty-labeled 14 thoracic findings (incl. Lung Lesion, Lung Opacity), board-certified radiologist test set & CheXpert Plus paired reports
datasets.cli_hint: # Download via Stanford AIMI Shared Datasets portal (CheXpert-v1.0-small)

datasets.name: PadChest
datasets.annotations: 174 detailed radiographic findings (pulmonary nodule, mass, cavitary lesion, hilar enlargement), 19 differential diagnoses & 104 anatomical locations
datasets.cli_hint: # Available via BIMCV PadChest portal & Hugging Face mirrors

datasets.name: VinDr-CXR & NIH ChestX-ray14
datasets.annotations: 3-radiologist consensus bounding boxes for 22 findings (incl. Nodule/Mass, Lung Opacity) in VinDr-CXR + 14 disease labels & boxes in NIH-14

benchmarks.name: NLST 1-6 Year Lung Cancer Risk
benchmarks.description: Long-horizon incident lung cancer prediction from a single baseline low-dose screening CT without manual nodule bounding boxes.

benchmarks.name: LUNA25 Indeterminate Nodule Malignancy
benchmarks.cohort: NLST Screening Indeterminate Nodules (4,069 CTs, AI vs. Radiologists)
benchmarks.description: International RSNA/MICCAI benchmark comparing AI malignancy risk estimators directly against thoracic radiologists on screening-detected nodules.

benchmarks.name: CT-RATE 18-Abnormality 3D Triage
benchmarks.cohort: CT-RATE Validation (3,039 volumes, 18 findings incl. Lung Nodule)
benchmarks.description: Multi-abnormality volumetric chest CT classification evaluating zero-shot contrastive VLMs and vocabulary fine-tuned models.

benchmarks.name: MSD Task06 Lung & Thoracic 3D Seg
benchmarks.cohort: MSD Task06 NSCLC Tumor (n=96) & TotalSegmentator Thorax (117 classes)
benchmarks.description: 3D volumetric segmentation accuracy on primary non-small cell lung cancer tumors and thoracic anatomical structures.

benchmarks.name: ReXrank & CheXbench (CXR Reporting)
benchmarks.description: Standardized public leaderboard for clinical accuracy, entity/relation fidelity (RadGraph-F1), and spatial grounding in chest X-ray report generation.

benchmarks.name: Multi-Cohort CXR Pathology Classification
benchmarks.cohort: CheXpert, MIMIC-CXR, NIH ChestX-ray14, PadChest & VinDr-CXR
benchmarks.description: Cross-institutional thoracic disease classification (including lung nodule, mass, consolidation, effusion, pneumothorax) testing linear probes and zero-shot transfer.

benchmarks.name: LUNA16 Pulmonary Nodule Detection
benchmarks.description: Competition Performance Metric (CPM): mean sensitivity across 7 false-positive operating points (0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8 FPs/scan).

benchmarks.name: AutoPET Oncologic FDG-PET/CT Lesion Seg
benchmarks.cohort: 1,014 Whole-Body FDG-PET/CT Studies (Lung Cancer, Lymphoma, Melanoma)
benchmarks.description: Multi-tracer oncologic PET/CT lesion delineation balancing foreground Dice against false-positive volume in negative control scans.

ecosystem.name: Project MONAI & Model Zoo
ecosystem.description: PyTorch-native toolkit hosting VISTA3D, MAISI, SwinUNETR, lung nodule detection bundles, and DICOM/NIfTI transforms.

ecosystem.name: NCI Imaging Data Commons (IDC) & TCIA
ecosystem.description: Cloud-hosted DICOM/SEG access to NLST, LIDC-IDRI, NSCLC-Radiomics, NSCLC-Radiogenomics, and Lung-PET-CT-Dx via `idc-index`.

ecosystem.name: ACR Lung-RADS v2022 & Fleischner Guidelines
ecosystem.description: Standardized screening and incidental pulmonary nodule volumetric management categories mapped directly into portal demo reports.

ecosystem.name: 3D Slicer, NiBabel & TorchXRayVision
ecosystem.description: Open-source NIfTI/DICOM-SEG visualization (3D Slicer + MONAI Label) and standardized multi-dataset CXR benchmark loaders.

ecosystem.name: Hugging Face Medical & Open-Weight Hub
ecosystem.description: Central checkpoint registry for Pillar-0, CT-RATE/CT-CLIP, CT-FM, RAD-DINO, MAIRA-2, CheXagent, MedGemma, and BiomedParse.
